skill.name: executing-plans
skill.description: Use to execute a written implementation plan in batches with critical review, verification, and feedback checkpoints.
skill.summary: Guides AI coding assistants through batched plan execution with review checkpoints.
skill.author: Cygnusfear

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only skill file. Manual review found no prompt injection attempt, data exfiltration intent, or unsafe execution instructions.

content.value_statement: Long implementation plans can drift when tasks are executed without review. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through batched execution, verification, and feedback checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Directs the assistant to read and critique a written implementation plan before starting.
Breaks execution into default batches of three tasks.
Requires verification for each task according to the plan.
Prompts progress reports with implemented changes and verification output.
Defines stop conditions for blockers, unclear instructions, and repeated failures.
Routes final completion through a finishing development branch sub-skill.
limitations: Does not create the implementation plan itself.
Does not execute commands or modify files by itself; it only guides the assistant.
Depends on the plan having clear tasks and verification steps.
References a finishing sub-skill that must exist for the final step.

use_cases.title: Implement A Prepared Plan
use_cases.description: Execute a reviewed implementation plan in small batches while keeping verification visible.

use_cases.title: Coordinate AI Coding Sessions
use_cases.description: Keep Claude, Codex, or Claude Code aligned with a plan across a separate work session.

use_cases.title: Review Progress Between Batches
use_cases.description: Pause after each batch so stakeholders can inspect changes before the next tasks begin.

prompt_templates.title: Start A Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a prepared task list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill. Read this implementation plan, review it for concerns, and start the first batch if it is clear.

prompt_templates.title: Execute First Batch
prompt_templates.scenario: Standard use for early implementation work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill with this plan. Execute the first three tasks, run each listed verification, and report the results for review.

prompt_templates.title: Resume After Feedback
prompt_templates.scenario: Continue after a reviewer accepts or changes the previous batch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill to continue from the last completed batch. Apply this feedback first, then execute the next planned tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Handle A Blocked Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced use when the plan may contain unclear or failing steps.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill. If any instruction is unclear or verification fails repeatedly, stop and explain the blocker before continuing.

output_examples.input: A developer provides a migration plan with ten verified tasks.
output_examples.output: The assistant reviews the plan, completes the first three tasks, shows verification results, and waits for feedback.

output_examples.input: A test fails twice during a planned implementation batch.
output_examples.output: The assistant stops the batch, describes the failing verification, and asks for clarification instead of guessing.

output_examples.input: All planned tasks are complete and verified.
output_examples.output: The assistant moves to the finishing development branch process and presents final verification options.

best_practices: Provide a clear plan file with small tasks and explicit verification steps.
Review each batch report before asking the assistant to continue.
Keep feedback specific so the next batch can resume with minimal ambiguity.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill when no written implementation plan exists.
Do not ask the assistant to skip verification between tasks.
Do not continue after a blocker without clarifying the failed or unclear step.

faq.question: Does this skill write an implementation plan?
faq.answer: No. It is designed to execute a plan that already exists.

faq.question: How many tasks are executed at once?
faq.answer: The default batch is three tasks unless the plan or user gives different instructions.

faq.question: Does it require review checkpoints?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill asks the assistant to report progress and wait for feedback between batches.

faq.question: Can it recover from failed verification?
faq.answer: It tells the assistant to stop, report the failure, and ask for help when verification repeatedly fails.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What does it do when all tasks are complete?
faq.answer: It directs the assistant to use a finishing development branch workflow for final verification and handoff.
